summary: Rapid7 Exposure Command Ultimate: cloud, application and infrastructure risk in one place, covering vulnerabilities, cloud settings, containers, IaC and application testing.
value: One risk queue for network, cloud and applications.
Cloud misconfigurations and vulnerable containers are found before an attack.
Web applications are tested for vulnerabilities before an attacker does it.
simple: Brings cloud, application and infrastructure risks together in one place. Finds vulnerabilities in the network, on computers, in cloud resources and in containers; checks AWS, Azure, GCP and Kubernetes configurations against CIS and compliance standards; analyzes access permissions and attack paths; scans infrastructure as code; spots threats in the cloud and automatically fixes violations; tests web applications, APIs and AI applications (DAST). Also shows the whole attack surface, has a risk dashboard for executives and includes automation (SOAR).
classification: CNAPP (cloud, containers, IaC, access rights) and DAST are added on top of Essentials.
